plain: In the 1950s, according to a lawyer and researcher named Dan Sheehan, Canada ran a project called the Avrocar, which a podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes as an attempt to build a flying saucer. Sheehan says the project was then moved to Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, under the name Project Y bug. It is told to show that governments were trying to build saucer-shaped craft themselves.
